title: The theorem extends to stochastic dynamics

statements.text: With state sufficiency written as a conditional independence, $\Pr(X_{t+\Delta} \mid X_{\le t}, I) = \Pr(X_{t+\Delta} \mid X_t, I)$, equal states and inputs give equal laws for the future, while a causally efficacious consciousness difference needs the laws to differ. The same contradiction follows, and the conclusion is unchanged.

sources.quote: The theorem extends directly to stochastic dynamics.
The contradiction in 4.8 follows. The conclusions therefore follow unchanged.
